Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:
Nickel Cadmium Battery
Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1 on 48 V DC battery, which must be performed every two 
months as indicated by M2 in the title block.

Technical 
Specification:
Rectifier Input
Rectifier Output

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy 
 WEDCO. inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Use Standard personnel safety equipment, 
goggles, rubber, gloves, rubber apron, eye rinsing device.
No smoking is permitted in battery room.

Do not place any tools on top of battery cells 
(Danger of short circuit) .

Never use the same tools on these cells, you 
may be used before on lead acid cells

Tools 
and Equipment
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

Standard screwdrivers set, density meter, voltmeter, brushes, distilled water, 
and rags.

items: Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

Standard screwdrivers set, density meter, voltmeter, brushes, distilled water, 
and rags.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

items: Read overall voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card.
Clean the dust of battery.

Check the electrolyte level and add distilled water (if necessary) to the 
 maximum level if the cells are completely charged and to 10 mm below the 
 maximum level if they are discharged.

Check the pole and connectors and clean any salt deposits with distilled 
 water.
Check that connections are tightened.
Lubricate the pole and connectors with Vaseline including the disco and nuts.
Read voltage per cell and record on battery maintenance.

Inspect the electrolyte density and record on battery maintenance card (1.19 
 kg I)

Again read overall voltage of bank and record on battery maintenance card and 
 compare the reading from step no. I
Compare the present reading with the last reading.

Check the temperature inside the battery room not exceeding 45 C maximum and 
 20 C minimum.
Check the ventilation of the battery room to ensure their correct operation.
